sections.fullText: Five Ways To Make Diwali Really Special

paragraphs: Our favorite festival is right around the corner and we must say, after this year’s COVID rollercoaster, it couldn’t come at a better time!
For many of us, this is the time to give. Buildings are collecting a “Deepavali funds"
for the staff;companies are handing out bonuses and charities around the country are gearing up for donations.

The festivities bring people together; they celebrate new beginnings and share their happiness. For the kind at heart, the festival is marked by reaching out to the less fortunate and donating to charity. Today, we’d like to bring to you five ways in which you can make Diwali really special this year.
There are hundreds of other NGOs and Foundations near you that could benefit from your donations and guess what, they are all on the SevaDeep platform!
Visit us today to make a donation to the NGO near you and put a smile on the faces of those who are less fortunate.
Don’t forget to stay in touch with SevaDeep’s activities on Facebook.
lists: Replace your children’s old toys with new ones and donate your old ones to Shree Santraj Yogi Shikshan Sanstha. The Pune based NGO operates an orphanage and addresses all the needs of children that lost their families.

Cook the grandest meal ever but add a few more items to donate to the Maya Care Centre. The Maya Care Centre is an old age home that has been serving the elderly for the last 7 years. The foundation has 25 beneficiaries and is located in Pune. They need Wheat, Rice, Peanuts, Oil and Masale. For more information, click here

Buy new clothes for family members and donate your old ones to Dnyanjyoti Bahuuddeshiya Sanstha. This foundation works round the clock to ensure the underprivileged have good clothes to wear. Their work benefits hundreds of people from the ages of 10 to 65+.

Bring home new warm winter blankets and send your old ones to Vidya Edu IX Foundation. The organisation is still working round the clock to help families in the Wambhori village, who were affected by heavy floods earlier this year. For more information, click here.

Did you decide to gift yourself a new dining set? Shree Santraj Yogi Shikshan Sanstha could really use your old one! The foundation is in urgent need of plates and spoons to feed the underprivileged families it supports on a daily basis.
